name: Engineering Labs
summary: Deep within Gnomeregan, the Engineering Labs lie in ruin, their tiers linked to the Workshop Entrance and Launch Bay. Once a busy center of gnome innovation, they were overrun in the city's radioactive cataclysm. Crazed leper gnomes and rogue mechanical contraptions now fill the chambers.

sections.title: A Fallen Center of Innovation
sections.body: The Engineering Labs were once a busy center of gnome innovation. Built around a central mechanical structure, they span two main tiers joined by a central cargo lift. At Gnomeregan's height, tinkerers developed schematics and refined clockwork inventions here. Radiation drove the remaining researchers mad, turning them into deranged leper gnomes who mindlessly guard malfunctioning machinery alongside rogue constructs.

sections.title: Crucial Junction
sections.body: The Engineering Labs also link routes through the lower reaches of the ruined city. Passages lead toward the Launch Bay, Tinkers' Court, and the Workshop Entrance back door. On the lower floor, Matrix Punchograph 3005-D terminals process coded punch cards carried by gnome engineers.

faq.q: What were the Engineering Labs originally used for?
faq.answer: Before the city fell, the Engineering Labs were used to research, assemble, and test complex gnome contraptions and automated devices. Engineers and technicians used the vast two-level chamber to blueprint new technology.

faq.q: What threats roam the Engineering Labs now?
faq.answer: Irradiated leper gnomes and haywire mechanical automatons roam both tiers. Irradiated gas released during the city's fall drove these lingering residents completely mad, and they attack any non-irradiated intruders on sight.

faq.q: What are the Matrix Punchograph 3005-D machines?
faq.answer: Matrix Punchograph 3005-D machines are automated gnomish data terminals on the lower level of the Engineering Labs. Engineers and adventurers use them to punch encoded data cards, advance their security clearance, and decipher technical archives preserved within the city.

faq.q: How does this area connect to the rest of Gnomeregan?
faq.answer: The upper level connects to the Workshop Entrance back door and passages toward the Launch Bay. The lower level leads to main corridors linking the Launch Bay and Tinkers' Court.

angles.text: The Engineering Labs hold the pinnacle of fallen gnomish automation, with functional automated punchograph terminals and discarded schematics amid the wreckage.
As an exiled gnome, you see a tragic ruin: these laboratories were once the heart of your people's technological triumphs, but now irradiated ruins are overrun by your corrupted kin.
